answer: Embodied Challenge-Response. Each identity must continuously answer randomized physical-world sensor challenges (e.g., photograph a local lotus bloom at a specified coordinate and time) validated by cross-referencing independent data sources like weather and satellite imagery. An attacker needs one real field agent per identity to reach an oasis or similar landmark, so spoofing costs full-time physical labor per account. A raven sighting challenge further ties answers to unpredictable live conditions.
